name: CLARYEL Box Core
proposalName: CLARYEL Box Core: Voice-to-GitOps NixOS for Private AI and Hardware-Integrated Edge Systems
description: A free and open NixOS control plane for private AI and hardware-integrated edge systems. Local intent becomes an explainable Git-compatible change, passes schema and risk-policy checks, receives approval according to impact, builds a pinned NixOS generation, validates services and hardware and rolls back on failure.
currentLimitations: No public end-to-end Voice-to-GitOps runtime exists.
No hardware profile has public validation evidence.
Home Assistant and MQTT integration remains in private testing.
Atomic activation and mutable-state recovery remain planned.
